messages:
maya: Heads up — bringing sylph-v0.1 (fp16 -> q4x) onto staging for multilingual smoke. Quick run shows weird detok quirks for mixed CJK+RTL contexts, plus a small BLEU drop on zh->en. tagging eng-ml :eyes:
jiang: repro samples? can you paste an example input + output?
sam: if it's q4x maybe kernel rounding or token id mapping issue. did we run the same tokenizer bundle as prod? :thinking:
maya: repro below — simple zh/arabic mixed line we use in eval set:
```
input: "今天天气不错 — لقاء الأصدقاء عند الكافيه."  # zh + arabic mix
reference: "The weather is nice today — meeting friends at the cafe."
```
output (sylph-v0.1 q4x): "Today the weather is good — لقاء الأصدقاء عند the cafe."
notes: arabic fragment partially detok'd (some words preserved), bracket/quote direction seems fine but interleaved scripts get half-detok.
tariq: can you paste tokenizer ids for that sentence (prod tok bundle vs sylph's tokenizer)? might be subtle mapping of fullwidth punctuation or ZWJ.
maya: quick diff of token ids pasted — prod vs sylph tokens (first 20):
prod: [1023, 4567, 890, 334, 9982, 10, 2234, 77, 4003]
sylph: [1023, 4567, 890, 334, 9982, 10, 2234, 77, 4003, 9999]  # extra sentinel id near arabic boundary
jiang: oh that extra id smells like a placeholder for unknown subtoken. maybe new vocab merge step introduced a collision. any recent tokenizer merges?
sam: also check kv-cache split boundaries. q4x packing changed chunk sizes in runtime earlier this week — could misalign byte offsets leading to partial detok.
maya: ran a small bisect: sylph w/ fp16 (no quant) => output matches prod detok. sylph q4x on cpu emu reproduces partial-preserved arabic.
eval-bot: quick metrics snapshot (eval set: multilingual-scan-1k):
- prod-model (fp16): zh->en BLEU: 28.6, zh detok mismatch rate: 0.9%
- sylph-v0.1 fp16: BLEU: 28.4, detok mismatch: 1.2%
- sylph-v0.1 q4x: BLEU: 26.9, detok mismatch: 4.7%  :bug:
maya: that's a big jump in detok mismatch for q4x. suspect quant kernel or vocab remap when packing embeddings. any idea which layer could introduce extra sentinel id?
tariq: can you dump the tokenizer vocab slice and the embedding table hash for that sentinel id? also try running sylph q4x with `--tokenizer-bundle=prod` as a quick check.
maya: tried `--tokenizer-bundle=prod` — detok improves but not fully fixed (detok mismatch 2.1%). so two contributors: token bundle differences + quantized embedding lookup.
sam: next steps: (1) run q4x with fp16 embeddings (prevent embedding quantization) (2) enable verbose token-id tracing to see when extra id inserted (3) reproduce minimal kernel with just embedding lookup to see mapping. I'll take (1) and (3).
jiang: I'll dump vocab merges and run a small script to compare subtokenization boundaries across CJK/Arabic heuristics. share path and I'll run locally.
maya: path: s3://redwood-staging/sylph/v0.1/token-dumps/6792001234/ ; also saved a failing log at /tmp/sylph-detok-fail.log
sam: starting embedding-lookup smoke now. will ping when I have numbers.
eval-bot: note: created eval ticket #EV-2026-118 (autogenerated) with samples and metrics.
maya: thanks — feel free to @pager if it looks like rollback needed. for now I'll hold the sylph canary on staging. :handshake:
